notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0004] Exclude bool from integer validation: When validating integer fields, check `isinstance(x, bool)` first because `bool` subclasses `int`; otherwise `True` would pass a positive-integer check.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary values with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0002] Normalize prices with to_money and ZERO: In ledgerly/invoice.py, coerce line prices with to_money() and seed sums with ZERO from ledgerly.money, as line_total and invoice_total already do.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 1 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid billing input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and pass `repr(value)` as the detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc
item.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`). Apply it to both the argument and `sub.started_at`.

candidate.title: Raise BillingError for invalid inputs
candidate.content: Signal invalid domain inputs by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` rather than ValueError/asserts; e.g. reject non-positive or bool `period_days` with code `invalid_period_days`.

candidate.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
candidate.content: Billing periods are computed as `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and `n = (at - start) // length`, then `start + n * length`; follow this pattern (as in `current_period`) for renewal math.
